function.name: list_skills
function.description: List or search skills in the Blender 3D skill library.

function.name: get_skill_info
function.description: Get detailed information about a Blender skill.

function.name: get_skill_code
function.description: Get full bpy code from a skill.

function.name: execute_blender_code
function.description: Execute arbitrary Python code in the Blender environment (bpy).

from_skill_ids.description: JSON/comma list of inspected wiki skill ids adapted by this code.

target_node.description: Object/material/lighting/composition role, or JSON/comma list for multiple grounded roles.

adaptation_notes.description: Short note describing the concrete mechanisms borrowed from the skills.

function.name: get_scene_info
function.description: Get current Blender scene information (objects, render engine, etc.).

function.name: get_viewport_screenshot
function.description: Render a quick viewport preview of the current scene.

function.name: add_object_from_skill
function.description: Execute a skill's code directly in Blender to add an object to the scene.

function.name: apply_scene_polish_pack
function.description: Apply deterministic scene-polish assets, materials, lighting, and camera adjustments before final render.

function.name: render_scene
function.description: Render the current scene to a PNG file in demo/blender/.

function.name: save_scene
function.description: Save the .blend file to demo/blender/.

function.name: list_material_presets
function.description: List PBR material preset names (metal_brushed, glass_frosted, water_ocean, foliage_green, fabric_velvet, ceramic_glossy, plastic_matte, concrete_raw, neon_emissive). Use these instead of writing raw Principled BSDF setups.

function.name: get_material_preset
function.description: Return the JSON for a material preset (Principled BSDF inputs).

function.name: apply_material_preset
function.description: Create a material from the preset and assign it to an existing object by name.

function.name: list_lighting_rigs
function.description: List lighting rig names (studio_3point, golden_hour, neon_corridor, overcast_overhead, dramatic_rim). Each rig is a curated set of lights + world settings for a specific mood.

function.name: get_lighting_rig
function.description: Return the JSON for a lighting rig.

function.name: apply_lighting_rig
function.description: Replace existing lights with a named lighting rig and configure world/background tone so exposure does not stack across attempts.

function.name: list_scene_shells
function.description: List complete scene shells (cyberpunk_corridor, forest_landscape, product_hero_shot, interior_living_room, sci_fi_exterior). A shell builds geometry + materials + lighting + camera in one call. Always check shells before building from primitives.

function.name: build_scene_from_shell
function.description: Build a complete themed scene from a shell. Resets the current scene, then runs the shell's build(**kwargs).

function.name: search_skills
function.description: Search wiki skills by task keywords, optionally filtered by tier or category_path.

function.name: get_skill_visual
function.description: Return the visual reference path for a wiki skill and attach it to the model when available.

function.name: apply_skill
function.description: Apply a wiki T3/T4/T5 Blender skill through the domain capability matrix.
